name: rfutils
description: Unified browser-based RF coordination + wireless-mic monitoring suite: WSM/WWB file exchange, Ofcom PMSE licence import, and live receiver monitoring in one package.

scripts.dev: npm run build:shared && concurrently -n server,web -c blue,magenta "RFUTILS_SERVER_PORT=8420 npm run dev -w @rfutils/server" "npm run dev -w @rfutils/web"
scripts.dev:server: npm run build:shared && RFUTILS_SERVER_PORT=8420 npm run dev -w @rfutils/server
scripts.dev:web: npm run build:shared && npm run dev -w @rfutils/web
scripts.dev:verify: npm run build:shared && concurrently -n server,web -c blue,magenta "RFUTILS_DISABLE_MONITOR=1 RFUTILS_SERVER_PORT=8420 npm run dev -w @rfutils/server" "npm run dev -w @rfutils/web"
scripts.dev:demo: npm run build:shared && concurrently -n server,web -c blue,magenta "RFUTILS_MOCK_DEVICES=1 RFUTILS_SERVER_PORT=8420 npm run dev -w @rfutils/server" "npm run dev -w @rfutils/web"
scripts.build: npm run build:shared && npm run build -w @rfutils/server && npm run build -w @rfutils/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @rfutils/shared && npm run typecheck -w @rfutils/server && npm run typecheck -w @rfutils/web
